notes.title: Re;Lord 2 ~The witch of Cologne and black cat~ Is here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32290091/a8051db0c1186e6cf4fe9ad291593d5a5279a2db.png[/img]

[h1]Re;Lord 2 ~The witch of Cologne and black cat~ Is here! [/h1]

We've kept you waiting, but now we're pleased to announce that Re;Lord 2 ~The witch of Cologne and black cat~ is officially out on Steam! Get your copy today and enjoy. Keep an eye out for more news on Re;Lord 3 ~The demon lord of Groessen and the final witch~, the final volume in the series! PS: You must be logged in to Steam and have adult content settings turned on to view the store page for Re;Lord 2. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1502770/ReLord_2_The_witch_of_Cologne_and_black_cat/

notes.title: Re;Lord 1 OST Now Available!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32290091/d2b84c04692b0bce0feb0b92923d326dfc59c07c.jpg[/img]
The OST for Re;Lord 1 is now available as DLC on Steam! Currently there's a launch discount so now is the perfect time to pick it up and enjoy~ There are 22 tracks in total featuring music from the game and is available in FLAC or WAV format. You can view all the track listings & details on the store page for the DLC. 

We hope this OST will put you into that conquering mood~

notes.title: Re;Lord2 Announced!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32290091/c61d0738376cb5e2075f0d392a48929b5a967144.jpg[/img]
Fans of Re;Lord will be happy to know that Re;Lord2 will be coming soon to steam! This is the second title in the Re;Lord trilogy that focuses on new girls (fans of Erika and Fine don't worry, they're still around as well)! Re;Lord2 is currently fully translated & edited while engine work is still ongoing at this time. We hope you all are looking forward to the next chapter in this series coming soon! :fineshock:
